manuscript_readiness_reason: No bias-size pass threshold is selected. Results remain manuscript-ready=false because this is a finite synthetic-noise study with an assumed real lambda and no material-specific vertex or confidence-region coverage validation.
limitations: The noise is synthetic independent complex Gaussian noise.
Lambda is a real assumed local-operator coefficient, not a measured material vertex.
The reduced 50/25 realization design estimates sensitivity but not publication-grade tail probabilities.
Multistart local least squares does not certify a global optimum.
